visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-angle shot from an airplane window, capturing a silver wing with a red insignia against a bright, clear blue sky and a white cloud layer. Mount Fuji's snow-capped peak is visible in the distance through the haze. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) A series of close-up cuts show various airplane meal trays. A JAL meal tray is displayed on a grey fold-down table, featuring white rectangular bowls with rice, meat, and vegetables, plus a small cup of vanilla ice cream. The camera angle is top-down, focusing on the food's arrangement. (3) The scene shifts to an exterior shot of a white Starlux airplane on a rainy tarmac with ground service vehicles. This is followed by a close-up of a Starlux meal with grilled pork over rice and a shot of a large seatback screen playing an animated video. (4) An ANA airplane is shown parked at a gate under clear skies. Subsequent shots feature different ANA meal configurations, including one with a brown mushroom and broccoli, and another with a yellow omelet and side salads. The lighting transitions to bright indoor cabin light. (5) A China Airlines meal tray with a bread roll, a cup of tea, and various side dishes is shown, followed by an exterior of an EVA Air plane. A close-up reveals a pasta dish topped with red shrimp sauce and broccoli. (6) A Cathay Pacific plane is shown at a boarding bridge. The final food shots show a tray with pork rice and a Haagen-Dazs cup. The video concludes with a pink graphic screen featuring white text and social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.
